Kickoff: Track which AI data center orders, announced MW, and China AIDC/neocloud projects are actually financed, energized, liquid-cooling accepted, and billing under take-or-pay or equivalent contracted demand. Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when the covered project universe is classified by named site into at least three evidence tiers: energized and billing, funded with firm power/cooling acceptance pending, or announced capacity without verifiable power/cooling/customer acceptance.

Determine whether the 1.40% NIM floor weakens LGFV bid support

Owner: financials-analyst · Thesis v4 · Ticks: 2 · Materials: 49 · Deadline: 13d left · project_id: rp_24cbedd2c95e4413

Kickoff: Track whether the hard NIM floor around 1.40% forces small banks to reduce low-rating LGFV bond bids or liquidity support. This matters because a bank-profit constraint could transmit into local-government credit spreads even if headline bank solvency remains intact.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when credit-spread evidence and bank balance-sheet data show either that low-rating LGFV liquidity support has been cut by NIM-constrained small banks, or that deposit repricing, injections, RRR cuts, or other offsets preserve the bid despite the NIM floor.

Working hypothesis: The NIM floor is a real constraint, and its first credit-market expression should appear in weaker small-bank demand for low-rating LGFV bonds rather than immediate bank solvency stress.

Owner: chief-economist · Thesis v4 · Ticks: 2 · Materials: 49 · Deadline: 13d left · project_id: rp_c4da49172b4347ab

Kickoff: Track whether Chinese government bonds break the 1.74%-1.85% range or settle into a split regime around 1.74% and 2.18% under PBOC guidance. This matters for RMB, A-share liquidity, China duration positioning, and the global rates divergence framework.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when 10-year CGB yields either sustain a break outside the 1.74%-1.85% range for a full trading week with confirming PBOC action, or the curve establishes a persistent 1.74%/2.18% split regime.

First trigger of JPY carry unwind

Owner: global-macro · Thesis v7 · Ticks: 4 · Materials: 195 · Deadline: 9d left · project_id: rp_310c90536b634b94

Kickoff: Track which catalyst actually forces the carry trade to unwind: a BoJ hawkish turn, USD/JPY breaking key downside levels, CNH/HIBOR stress, or a US rates reversal. This matters because the analyst treats carry unwind as the macro variable that can push risk baskets, including biotech, into high-correlation liquidation.

Resolution criterion (the stop condition): Resolved when one candidate trigger occurs first and is followed by observable unwind confirmation: USD/JPY below 152 or 140, offshore funding stress, broad risk de-grossing, and biotech sub-basket correlations moving toward 0.90+; or when those trigger conditions pass without a material carry unwind.
